questions.question_english: To reduce the free-rider problem in a group incentive scheme, what should an educational administrator do?
options_english: Make the size of the operational group as large and expansive as possible
Give the allocated group reward exclusively to the designated team leader
Withhold the reward entirely if even one member makes a minor operational mistake

questions.explanation_english: To mitigate the free-rider problem within group incentive schemes, administrators must ensure that individual contributions are transparent, measurable, and subject to peer evaluation. Expanding group size increases free-riding risks, withholding rewards entirely penalizes dedicated workers unfairly, and rewarding only team leaders destroys overall group motivation.

questions.topic: Role of Incentives in Building Morale

Automatically doubling the annual basic pay of all teachers who achieve 100% board pass results

questions.explanation_english: The correct option is a, as 'stepping up' of pay is an administrative corrective mechanism designed to eliminate financial pay anomalies where a senior employee draws less basic pay than a junior counterpart due to specific fixation rules.
